ko.title: 주택 보험은 새로운 주거비 충격입니다: 청구를 한 번도 하지 않은 소유자에게도 보험료가 계속 오르는 이유

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: 많은 주택 소유자들에게 올해 가장 반갑지 않은 우편물은 세금 고지서나 모기지 명세서가 아니었습니다.

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: 그것은 보험사의 갱신 통지서였습니다.

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: 두 자리 수 인상이 여러 주에서 흔해졌으며, 가장 큰 타격을 입은 지역에서는 일부 소유자들이 아예 보험이 갱신되지 않을 것이라는 통보를 받기도 했습니다.

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: 단 한 번의 청구도 한 적이 없는 가계에게 이러한 급등은 당혹스럽고 불공평하게 느껴질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: 그 이유는 보험 비즈니스의 작동 방식에 있습니다.

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: 주택 소유자의 보험료는 해당 가계 자체의 이력만을 반영한 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: 이는 훨씬 더 큰 위험 풀의 일부이며, 그 풀은 여러 측면에서 동시에 비용이 더 많이 들게 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## 아무 잘못을 하지 않았는데도 보험료가 오르는 이유

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: 보험은 풀링(위험 분산)을 기반으로 구축됩니다.

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: 수천 명의 계약자가 보험료를 내고, 그 자금은 특정 연도에 손해를 입은 소수의 청구를 지급하는 데 사용됩니다.

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: 풀 전체의 손실이 증가하면 개별 소유자가 청구를 제기했는지 여부와 관계없이 해당 풀에 속한 모든 사람의 보험료도 오르는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: 보험사는 일반적으로 단일 고객의 기록보다는 지역, 주택 특성, 위험 모델에 따라 요금을 설정합니다.

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: 이웃의 지붕이 우박으로 파손되거나 해당 지역에 비용이 많이 드는 폭풍이 잇따라 발생하는 경우, 귀하와 같은 주택을 보장하는 데 드는 예상 비용이 증가합니다.

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: 깨끗한 청구 이력으로 소폭의 할인을 받을 수는 있지만, 시장 전체의 변화를 상쇄할 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## 인상을 주도하는 세 가지 요인

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. 폭풍 및 날씨 손실

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: 우박과 강풍을 포함한 심각한 대류성 폭풍은 허리케인, 산불, 더 취약한 지역의 홍수와 함께 국가 여러 지역에서 보험 손실의 주요 원인이 되었습니다.

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: 보험사들은 일부 주의 주택 보험 라인에서 지급금이 거두어들인 보험료를 초과하는 해가 몇 년 동안 지속되었다고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: 적당한 이벤트라도 여러 부동산에서 빈번하게 발생하면 그 영향이 누적됩니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. 재건축 비용 상승

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: 주택 소유자 보험은 일반적으로 시장 가격으로 주택을 구매하는 것이 아니라 수리 또는 재건축 비용을 지불하도록 설계되어 있습니다.

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 재건축 비용은 목재, 지붕 자재, 가전제품, 노동력, 인허가에 따라 달라지며, 이 모든 것이 최근 몇 년 동안 급등했습니다.

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: 건설 비용이 상승하면 보험사가 전손 또는 부분 손실 시 지불해야 하는 금액도 함께 상승합니다.

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: 많은 정책이 이에 대해 자동으로 조정되므로 집 자체가 변경되지 않더라도 보장 한도와 보험료가 함께 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: 건축 업계의 노동력 부족과 업데이트된 건축 법규를 충족하는 데 드는 비용이 압박을 가중시킵니다.

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: 몇 년 전에는 특정 비용이 들었던 수리가 오늘날에는 눈에 띄게 더 많은 비용이 들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. 재보험 가격

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: 보험사 자체도 대형 재난 연도에 대비하기 위해 재보험으로 알려진 보험에 가입합니다.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: 재보험사들은 대규모 재난 손실에 대응하여 가격을 인상하고 조건을 강화했으며, 이러한 비용은 원수보험사에 전가됩니다.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: 재보험 계약은 대개 정해진 연간 일정에 따라 갱신되기 때문에 인상분이 소비자 요금에 지연되어 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: 더 높은 비용을 일시적으로 흡수한 보험사는 결국 따라잡기 위해 더 큰 요금 인상을 모색할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: 보험사는 잠재적 손실에 대비해 적립금을 유지해야 하므로 고금리와 자본 비용도 중요한 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## 일부 소유자가 보장을 잃는 이유

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: 요금 인상은 이야기의 일부분일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: 일부 고위험 지역에서는 보험사가 신규 보험 인수를 중단하거나 기존 보험 갱신을 거부하거나 보장하는 주택 수를 줄였습니다.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: 주 규제 기관은 일반적으로 요금 인상을 검토하고 승인하며, 일부 주에서는 승인 절차로 인해 보험사가 가격을 인상할 수 있는 속도가 제한됩니다.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: 보험사가 허용된 요금이 위험과 일치하지 않는다고 믿을 때, 대신 노출을 줄이는 것을 선택할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: 표준 시장에서 보장을 찾을 수 없는 소유자는 종종 FAIR 플랜 또는 유사한 프로그램이라고 불리는 주 지원 최종 수단 보험사에 의존할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: 이러한 플랜은 더 비쌀 수 있으며 더 좁은 보호를 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: 모기지 대출 기관은 주택 소유자 보장을 요구하므로 정책을 잃는 것은 단순히 불편한 일이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: 대출과 관련된 규정 준수 문제를 야기할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## 요금을 낮추기 위해 소유자가 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: 시장 전체의 인상을 완전히 피할 방법은 없지만 지불하는 금액을 줄일 수 있는 실용적인 단계가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **여러 보험사 알아보기.** 동일한 주택에 대한 요금은 보험사마다 크게 다를 수 있습니다. 여러 회사에서 견적을 받거나 여러 보험사를 비교할 수 있는 독립 대리점과 협력하세요. 갱신일 훨씬 전에 이 작업을 수행하세요.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **보장 금액 검토.** 주택이나 토지의 시장 가치가 아닌 현실적인 재건축 비용을 주거 제한이 반영하는지 확인하세요. 과도한 보험 가입은 돈을 낭비하고, 과소 보험 가입은 손실 후 위험에 노출될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **공제액 인상.** 더 높은 공제액을 선택하면 보험료를 낮출 수 있지만, 해당 금액을 본인 부담으로 편안하게 지불할 수 있는 경우에만 그렇게 하세요. 정책에 바람이나 우박에 대한 별도의 더 높은 공제액이 있는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **주택 강화.** 많은 보험사에서 최신 또는 충격에 강한 지붕, 폭풍 셔터, 업데이트된 배선 및 배관, 누수 센서, 모니터링되는 연기 또는 보안 시스템에 대한 할인을 제공합니다. 산불 지역에서는 식생 제거와 내화성 자재 사용이 중요할 수 있습니다. 어떤 개선 사항이 자격이 되는지 보험사에 정확히 문의하세요.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **정책 번들링.** 동일한 회사와 주택 및 자동차 보장을 결합하면 종종 할인을 받을 수 있지만, 번들 가격을 별도의 견적과 비교해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **사용 가능한 모든 할인 문의.** 여기에는 충성도, 무사사고, 전액 선납, 종이 없는 청구 및 퇴직자 할인이 포함될 수 있습니다. 자격은 회사 및 주에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **허용되는 경우 신용 관련 요소 확인.** 많은 주에서 보험사는 가격 책정 시 신용 기반 정보를 사용할 수 있습니다. 신용 보고서의 오류를 수정하는 것이 도움이 될 수 있지만 규칙은 주마다 다릅니다.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **소액 청구 전 두 번 생각하기.** 여러 건의 소액 청구를 제기하면 요금이 인상되거나 갱신에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 사소한 수리는 직접 지불하는 것이 더 나은지 고려해보세요.

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **정책의 예외 사항 이해.** 표준 정책은 일반적으로 홍수나 지진을 보장하지 않습니다. 별도의 보장을 받을 수 있으며, 무엇을 가지고 있고 무엇을 가지고 있지 않은지 아는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## 고비용 시대를 위한 계획

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: 주택 소유자는 재산세와 유지보수처럼 매년 크게 바뀔 수 있는 가계 예산의 한 줄로 보험을 취급해야 합니다.

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: 특히 구매자는 비용이 감당할 수 있는 주택 가격에 영향을 미칠 수 있으므로 주택을 마감하기 전에 보험 견적을 요청해야 합니다.

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: 공제액을 충당할 수 있는 비상 기금을 따로 마련해 두는 것도 현명합니다.

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: 합리적인 요금, 보험사 지불 능력, 지역 사회를 더 탄력적으로 만드는 데 대한 투자 사이의 균형을 맞추는 방법에 대한 지역 및 주 정책 토론이 계속되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: 결과가 어떻든 기상 위험, 건설 비용 및 재보험 가격의 근본적인 동인은 빠르게 반전될 것 같지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: 보험료가 오른다고 해서 반드시 잘못을 저질렀거나 보험사가 당신을 지목했다는 의미는 아닙니다.

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: 이는 비용이 많이 드는 폭풍, 더 비싼 수리, 더 비싼 백업 보장으로 인해 압박을 받고 있는 풀링된 시스템을 반영합니다.

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: 제안을 비교하고, 보장 규모를 적정화하고, 보호 업그레이드에 투자하는 소유자는 제거할 수는 없더라도 고통을 줄일 수 있는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Policies, regulations and available discounts vary by insurer and state.

zh.title: 房屋保险成为新的住房成本冲击：为什么即使是从未索赔过的业主，保费也在持续上涨

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: 对许多房屋拥有者来说，今年最不希望收到的邮件不是税单或按揭账单。

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: 而是来自保险公司的续保通知。

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: 在许多州，两位数的涨幅已成为常态，而在受创最严重的地区，一些业主甚至被告知其保单将完全不再续签。

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: 对于那些从未提出过一次索赔的家庭来说，这种大幅上涨可能会让人感到困惑和不公。

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: 原因在于保险业务的处理机制。

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: 房屋拥有者的保费并不单单反映该家庭自身的历史记录。

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: 它是更大的风险池中的一部分，而这个风险池在多个方面同时变得更加昂贵。

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## 为什么在你什么都没做的情况下保费还会上涨

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: 保险建立在风险共担（Pooling）的基础之上。

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: 数以万计的投保人缴纳保费，这些资金用于支付在特定年份遭受损失的少数人的索赔。

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: 当整个风险池的损失增加时，无论个人业主是否提出过索赔，该风险池中所有人的保费往往都会上涨。

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: 保险公司通常是根据区域、房屋特征和风险模型来制定费率，而不是仅凭单个客户的记录。

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: 如果邻居的屋顶被冰雹损坏，或者你所在的地区经历了一连串损失惨重的风暴，那么保障像你这样的房屋的预期成本就会上升。

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: 良好的无索赔记录可能会带给你适度的折扣，但它无法抵消整个市场范围内的趋势变化。

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## 推动保费上涨的三大推手

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. 风暴和天气损失

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: 在全国许多地区，包括冰雹和强风在内的严重强对流风暴已成为承保损失的主要来源，而在风险更大的地区，还有飓风、野火和洪水。

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: 保险公司报告称，在一些州，有几年赔付的金额超过了在房屋保险业务中收取的保费。

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: 即使是中等规模的灾害事件，如果频繁发生在大量房屋上，累积起来也会非常惊人。

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. 更高的重建成本

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: 房屋保险通常旨在支付修复或重建房屋的费用，而不是按其市场价格购买房屋。

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 重建成本取决于木材、屋顶材料、家电、劳工和许可证，所有这些费用在近年来都大幅上涨。

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: 当建筑成本上升时，保险公司为全损或部分损失必须支付的金额也随之上升。

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: 许多保单会自动对此做出调整，这意味着即使房屋本身没有改变，保额上限和保费也可能会一起上升。

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: 建筑行业的劳工短缺以及满足更新后的建筑规范的费用进一步加剧了压力。

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: 几年前花费一定金额的维修，今天可能需要花费明显更多的费用。

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. 再保险价格

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: 保险公司自身也会购买保险（称为再保险），以防御灾难性年份带来的风险。

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: 再保险公司为了应对重大的灾害损失，提高了价格并收紧了条款，而这些成本最终被传递给了初级保险公司。

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: 由于再保险合同通常按照固定的年度计划续签，因此费率上涨反映到消费者端可能会有滞后。

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: 一家吸收了一段时间更高成本的保险公司，最终可能会寻求更大的费率涨幅来补齐缺口。

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: 更高的利率和资本成本也发挥了作用，因为保险公司必须留存储备金以应对潜在的损失。

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## 为什么有些业主正在失去保障

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: 费率上涨只是冰山一角。

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: 在一些高风险地区，保险公司已停止出具新保单、拒绝续签现有保单，或减少了承保的房屋数量。

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: 州监管机构通常会审查并批准费率调整，而在某些州，审批流程限制了保险公司提价的速度。

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: 当保险公司认为允许的费率与风险不匹配时，他们可能会选择减少风险暴露。

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: 在标准市场上找不到保障的业主可能会转向由州政府支持的兜底保险公司，这些公司通常被称为 FAIR 计划或类似项目。

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: 这些计划可能更昂贵，且提供的保障范围可能更窄。

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: 按揭贷款人要求房屋拥有者购买保险，因此失去保单不仅是带来不便。

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: 它还可能导致贷款合规性问题。

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## 业主可以采取哪些措施来降低账单

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: 虽然无法完全躲避整个市场范围内的涨价，但有一些实际步骤可能会减少你的支出。

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **货比三家。** 同一套房屋在不同保险公司的费率可能相差很大。向多家公司获取报价，或与能提供多家承保公司对比的独立代理人合作。请在续保日期前尽早做好这件事。

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **审查你的保额。** 确保住宅保额上限反映的是现实的重建成本，而不是房屋或土地的市场价值。过度投保会浪费钱，而投保不足则可能在发生损失后让你面临风险。

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **提高免赔额（Deductible）。** 选择更高的免赔额可以降低保费，但前提是你能够轻松地自负该笔金额。检查你的保单对于风暴或冰雹是否设置了单独且更高的免赔额。

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **增强房屋抗灾能力（Hardening the home）。** 许多保险公司对较新或抗冲击的屋顶、防风暴百叶窗、更新的电线和管道、水泄漏传感器以及带监控的烟雾或安防系统提供折扣。在野火多发地区，清理植被和使用防火材料可能很重要。向你的保险公司精确询问哪些改进符合折扣条件。

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **捆绑保单。** 将房屋保险和汽车保险捆绑在同一家公司通常会获得折扣，不过你仍应将捆绑价格与单独报价进行对比。

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **询问所有可用的折扣。** 这可能包括忠诚折扣、无索赔折扣、全额付款折扣、无纸化账单折扣和退休人员折扣。资格因公司和州而异。

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **在允许的地区检查与信用相关的因素。** 在许多州，保险公司可能会在定价中使用基于信用的信息。纠正信用报告中的错误可能会有所帮助，尽管规则因州而异。

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **小额索赔前请三思。** 提交多次小额索赔可能会提高你的费率或影响续保。考虑直接自费支付小额维修是否更划算。

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **了解保单的除外责任。** 标准保单通常不涵盖洪水或地震。可能需要单独购买保障，了解哪些在保障范围内、哪些不在是很有必要的。

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## 为高成本时代做好规划

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: 房屋拥有者应该将保险视为家庭预算中每年可能会有大幅变化的一项支出，就像房产税和房屋维护费一样。

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: 尤其是买房者，在完成房屋过户之前应该先索取保险报价，因为这项成本会影响到他们能负担得起多贵的房子。

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: 预留一笔能覆盖免赔额的应急资金也是明智之举。

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: 关于如何在合理的费率、保险公司的偿付能力以及提高社区韧性的投资之间取得平衡，地方和州的政策讨论仍在继续。

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: 无论结果如何，天气风险、建筑成本和再保险定价等底层驱动因素短期内不太可能逆转。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: 保费上涨并不一定意味着你做错了什么，也不意味着保险公司在专门针对你。

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: 它反映出一个统筹体系正承受着来自更昂贵的风暴、更昂贵的维修以及更昂贵的后备保障的巨大压力。

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: 比较报价、合理调整保额并投资于防护升级的业主，往往可以减轻这种痛感，即使他们无法完全消除它。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成保险、财务或法律建议。

segments.src: Policies, regulations and available discounts vary by insurer and state.
segments.tr: 保单、法规和可享折扣因保险公司和州而异。

segments.tr: 请就您的具体情况咨询持牌保险专业人士。*

segments.tr: ### 1. तूफान और मौसम से नुकसान

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: ओलावृष्टि और तेज़ हवाओं सहित गंभीर संवहनी तूफान, अधिक संवेदनशील क्षेत्रों में तूफान, जंगल की आग और बाढ़ के साथ-साथ देश के कई हिस्सों में बीमित नुकसान का एक प्रमुख स्रोत बन गए हैं।

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ताओं ने ऐसे कई वर्षों की सूचना दी है जिनमें भुगतान कुछ राज्यों में गृहस्वामियों की श्रेणियों के लिए एकत्र किए गए प्रीमियम से अधिक हो गया था।

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: मध्यम घटनाएँ भी तब जुड़ जाती हैं जब वे कई संपत्तियों में बार-बार होती हैं।

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. पुनर्निर्माण की उच्च लागत

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: गृहस्वामी बीमा आम तौर पर किसी घर को उसके बाजार मूल्य पर खरीदने के लिए नहीं, बल्कि उसकी मरम्मत या पुनर्निर्माण के लिए भुगतान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: पुनर्निर्माण की लागत लकड़ी, छत की सामग्री, उपकरणों, श्रम और अनुमति (permitting) पर निर्भर करती है, जिनमें से सभी हाल के वर्षों में तेजी से बढ़े हैं।

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: जब निर्माण लागत बढ़ती है, तो कुल या आंशिक नुकसान पर बीमाकर्ता को जो राशि का भुगतान करना पड़ता है, वह भी उनके साथ बढ़ जाती है।

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: इसके लिए कई पॉलिसियों को स्वचालित रूप से समायोजित किया जाता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि घर में स्वयं कोई बदलाव न होने पर भी कवरेज सीमा और प्रीमियम एक साथ बढ़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: निर्माण ट्रेडों में श्रम की कमी और अद्यतन भवन कोड को पूरा करने का खर्च अतिरिक्त दबाव डालता है।

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: कुछ साल पहले जिस मरम्मत में एक निश्चित राशि खर्च होती थी, आज उसकी लागत काफी अधिक हो सकती है।

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. पुनर्बीमा (Reinsurance) की कीमतें

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ता स्वयं विनाशकारी वर्षों से रक्षा के लिए बीमा खरीदते हैं, जिसे पुनर्बीमा कहा जाता है।

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: पुनर्बीमाकर्ताओं ने बड़ी आपदाओं के नुकसान के जवाब में कीमतें बढ़ाई हैं और शर्तों को सख्त किया है, और वे लागत प्राथमिक बीमाकर्ताओं पर डाल दी जाती हैं।

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: क्योंकि पुनर्बीमा अनुबंध अक्सर एक निर्धारित वार्षिक कार्यक्रम के अनुसार नवीकृत होते हैं, वृद्धि उपभोक्ता दरों में देरी से दिखाई दे सकती है।

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: एक बीमाकर्ता जिसने कुछ समय के लिए उच्च लागत को अवशोषित किया है, वह अंततः बराबरी करने के लिए बड़ी दर वृद्धि की मांग कर सकता है।

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: उच्च ब्याज दरें और पूंजी की लागत भी एक भूमिका निभाती हैं, क्योंकि बीमाकर्ताओं को संभावित नुकसान के खिलाफ भंडार रखना पड़ता है।

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## कुछ मालिक कवरेज क्यों खो रहे हैं

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: दरों में वृद्धि कहानी का केवल एक हिस्सा है।

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: कुछ उच्च-जोखिम वाले क्षेत्रों में, बीमाकर्ताओं ने नई पॉलिसियां लिखना बंद कर दिया है, मौजूदा पॉलिसियों का नवीनीकरण करने से इनकार कर दिया है, या उनके द्वारा कवर किए जाने वाले घरों की संख्या कम कर दी है।

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: राज्य नियामक आमतौर पर दर परिवर्तनों की समीक्षा और अनुमोदन करते हैं, और कुछ राज्यों में अनुमोदन प्रक्रिया सीमित करती है कि बीमाकर्ता कितनी जल्दी कीमतें बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: जब बीमाकर्ताओं को लगता है कि अनुमत दरें जोखिम से मेल नहीं खाती हैं, तो वे इसके बजाय अपने जोखिम को कम करना चुन सकते हैं।

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: मालिक जो मानक बाज़ार में कवरेज नहीं पा सकते हैं, वे अंतिम उपाय के राज्य-समर्थित बीमाकर्ताओं की ओर रुख कर सकते हैं, जिन्हें अक्सर FAIR प्लान या इसी तरह के कार्यक्रम कहा जाता है।

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: ये योजनाएं अधिक महंगी हो सकती हैं और संकीर्ण सुरक्षा प्रदान कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: बंधक उधारदाताओं को गृहस्वामी कवरेज की आवश्यकता होती है, इसलिए पॉलिसी खोना केवल एक असुविधा नहीं है।

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: यह ऋण के अनुपालन (compliance) की समस्या पैदा कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## बिल कम करने के लिए मालिक क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: बाज़ार-व्यापी वृद्धि से पूरी तरह बचने का कोई तरीका नहीं है, लेकिन ऐसे व्यावहारिक कदम हैं जो आपके द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली राशि को कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **विभिन्न विकल्पों की तुलना करें (Shop around)।** एक ही घर के लिए दरें बीमाकर्ताओं के बीच व्यापक रूप से भिन्न हो सकती हैं। कई कंपनियों से कोटेशन प्राप्त करें या एक स्वतंत्र एजेंट के साथ काम करें जो कई वाहकों की तुलना कर सके। अपनी नवीनीकरण तिथि से काफी पहले ऐसा करें।

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **अपनी कवरेज राशि की समीक्षा करें।** सुनिश्चित करें कि आवास सीमा यथार्थवादी पुनर्निर्माण लागत को दर्शाती है, न कि घर या भूमि के बाजार मूल्य को। अधिक बीमा कराने से पैसा बर्बाद होता है, जबकि कम बीमा कराने पर नुकसान के बाद आपको नुकसान उठाना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **अपनी कटौती योग्य (deductible) राशि बढ़ाएं।** उच्च कटौती योग्य चुनने से आपका प्रीमियम कम हो सकता है, लेकिन ऐसा तभी करें जब आप जेब से उस राशि का आसानी से भुगतान कर सकें। जांचें कि क्या आपकी पॉलिसी में हवा या ओले के लिए अलग, अधिक कटौती योग्य राशि है।

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **घर को मजबूत करें।** कई बीमाकर्ता नई या प्रभाव-प्रतिरोधी छत, तूफान शटर, अद्यतन वायरिंग और प्लंबिंग, जल-रिसाव सेंसर और निगरानी वाले धुएं या सुरक्षा प्रणालियों के लिए छूट प्रदान करते हैं। जंगल की आग वाले क्षेत्रों में, वनस्पति को हटाना और अग्नि-प्रतिरोधी सामग्रियों का उपयोग करना मायने रख सकता है। अपने बीमाकर्ता से पूछें कि कौन से सुधार योग्य हैं।

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **पॉलिसियों को बंडल करें।** एक ही कंपनी के साथ घर और ऑटो कवरेज को जोड़ने पर अक्सर छूट मिलती है, हालांकि आपको बंडल की गई कीमत की अलग-अलग कोटेशन से तुलना करनी चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **सभी उपलब्ध छूटों के बारे में पूछें।** इनमें वफादारी (loyalty), दावा-मुक्त, पूर्ण भुगतान, पेपरलेस बिलिंग और सेवानिवृत्त छूट शामिल हो सकती हैं। पात्रता कंपनी और राज्य के अनुसार अलग-अलग होती है।

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **जहां अनुमति हो अपने क्रेडिट-संबंधित कारकों की जांच करें।** कई राज्यों में बीमाकर्ता मूल्य निर्धारण में क्रेडिट-आधारित जानकारी का उपयोग कर सकते हैं। आपकी क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट में त्रुटियों को ठीक करने से मदद मिल सकती है, हालांकि नियम राज्य के अनुसार भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **छोटे दावों से पहले दो बार सोचें।** कई छोटे दावे दायर करने से आपकी दरें बढ़ सकती हैं या नवीनीकरण प्रभावित हो सकता है। विचार करें कि क्या छोटी मरम्मत का भुगतान सीधे करना बेहतर है।

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **अपनी पॉलिसी के बहिष्करणों (exclusions) को समझें।** मानक पॉलिसियां आम तौर पर बाढ़ या भूकंप को कवर नहीं करती हैं। अलग कवरेज उपलब्ध हो सकता है, और यह जानना महत्वपूर्ण है कि आपके पास क्या है और क्या नहीं है।

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## उच्च-लागत वाले युग की योजना बनाना

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: गृहस्वामियों को बीमा को घरेलू बजट में एक ऐसी लाइन के रूप में देखना चाहिए जो संपत्ति करों और रखरखाव की तरह वर्ष-दर-वर्ष काफी बदल सकती है।

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: खरीदारों को विशेष रूप से घर खरीदने से पहले बीमा कोटेशन का अनुरोध करना चाहिए, क्योंकि लागत प्रभावित कर सकती है कि वे कितना महंगा घर खरीद सकते हैं।

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: कटौती योग्य राशि को कवर करने वाले आपातकालीन कोष को अलग रखना भी समझदारी है।

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: किफायती दरों, बीमाकर्ता की वित्तीय क्षमता (solvency) और समुदायों को अधिक लचीला बनाने में निवेश को कैसे संतुलित किया जाए, इस पर स्थानीय और राज्य नीति बहस जारी है।

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: परिणाम चाहे जो भी हो, मौसम के जोखिम, निर्माण लागत और पुनर्बीमा मूल्य निर्धारण के अंतर्निहित चालकों के जल्द ही उलटने की संभावना नहीं है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य निष्कर्ष

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: बढ़ते प्रीमियम का मतलब यह नहीं है कि आपने कुछ गलत किया है या आपकी बीमा कंपनी आपको अलग कर रही है।

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: यह अधिक महंगे तूफानों, अधिक महंगी मरम्मतों और अधिक महंगे बैकअप कवरेज के तनाव के तहत एक एकत्रित प्रणाली को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: जो मालिक प्रस्तावों की तुलना करते हैं, अपने कवरेज को सही आकार देते हैं और सुरक्षात्मक सुधारों में निवेश करते हैं, वे अक्सर इसके प्रभाव को कम कर सकते हैं, भले ही वे इसे पूरी तरह से समाप्त न कर सकें।

segments.src: Policies, regulations and available discounts vary by insurer and state.

es.title: El seguro de vivienda es el nuevo choque del costo de la vivienda: por qué las primas siguen subiendo incluso para los propietarios que nunca presentan un reclamo

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: Para muchos propietarios, la correspondencia más indeseada de este año no fue una factura de impuestos ni un estado de cuenta hipotecario.

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: Fue un aviso de renovación de su aseguradora.

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: Los aumentos de dos dígitos se han vuelto comunes en varios estados, y en las regiones más golpeadas a algunos propietarios se les ha dicho que sus pólizas no serán renovadas en absoluto.

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: Para los hogares que nunca han presentado un solo reclamo, el salto puede parecer desconcertante e injusto.

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: La explicación radica en cómo funciona el negocio de los seguros.

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: La prima de un propietario no es un reflejo únicamente del historial de ese hogar.

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: Es una parte de un fondo de riesgo mucho más grande, y ese fondo se ha vuelto más costoso en varios frentes a la vez.

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## Por qué sube tu prima cuando no hiciste nada

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: El seguro se basa en la mancomunión de riesgos.

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: Miles de asegurados pagan primas, y el dinero se utiliza para pagar los reclamos de los pocos que sufren pérdidas en un año determinado.

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: Cuando las pérdidas en todo el fondo aumentan, las primas para todos en ese fondo tienden a subir también, independientemente de si un propietario individual presentó un reclamo.

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras suelen establecer tarifas por territorio, características de la vivienda y modelos de riesgo en lugar del historial de un solo cliente.

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: Si los techos de tus vecinos sufren daños por granizo, o tu región experimenta una serie de tormentas costosas, el costo esperado de cubrir casas como la tuya aumenta.

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: Tu historial limpio de reclamos puede hacerte ganar un descuento modesto, pero no puede compensar un cambio a nivel de mercado.

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## Tres fuerzas que impulsan los aumentos

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. Pérdidas por tormentas y clima

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: Las tormentas convectivas severas, que incluyen granizo y vientos fuertes, se han convertido en una fuente importante de pérdidas aseguradas en muchas partes del país, junto con huracanes, incendios forestales e inundaciones en áreas más expuestas.

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras han informado varios años en los que los pagos superaron las primas recaudadas para las líneas de propietarios en algunos estados.

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: Incluso los eventos moderados se acumulan cuando ocurren con frecuencia en muchas propiedades.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. Costos de reconstrucción más altos

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: El seguro de propietarios generalmente está diseñado para pagar la reparación o reconstrucción de una casa, no para comprarla a su precio de mercado.

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: El costo de reconstruir depende de la madera, los materiales para techos, los electrodomésticos, la mano de obra y los permisos, todo lo cual aumentó drásticamente en los últimos años.

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: Cuando los costos de construcción suben, la cantidad que una aseguradora debe pagar por una pérdida total o parcial sube con ellos.

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: Muchas pólizas se ajustan automáticamente para esto, lo que significa que el límite de cobertura y la prima pueden subir juntos incluso si la casa en sí no ha cambiado.

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: La escasez de mano de obra en los oficios de la construcción y el gasto de cumplir con los códigos de construcción actualizados añaden mayor presión.

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: Una reparación que costaba una cierta cantidad hace unos años puede costar notablemente más hoy.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. Precios de la reaseguranza

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras mismas compran seguros, conocidos como reaseguros, para protegerse contra años catastróficos.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: Los reaseguradores han subido los precios y endurecido los términos en respuesta a grandes pérdidas por desastres, y esos costos se trasladan a las aseguradoras principales.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: Debido a que los contratos de reaseguro a menudo se renuevan en un horario anual fijo, los aumentos pueden aparecer en las tarifas de los consumidores con un retraso.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: Una aseguradora que absorbió costos más altos por un tiempo puede eventualmente buscar mayores aumentos de tarifas para ponerse al día.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: Las tasas de interés más altas y el costo del capital también juegan un papel, ya que las aseguradoras deben mantener reservas contra posibles pérdidas.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## Por qué algunos propietarios están perdiendo cobertura

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: Los aumentos de tarifas son solo una parte de la historia.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: En algunas áreas de alto riesgo, las aseguradoras han dejado de emitir nuevas pólizas, se han negado a renovar las existentes o han reducido el número de casas que cubren.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: Los reguladores estatales generalmente revisan y aprueban los cambios de tarifas, y en algunos estados el proceso de aprobación limita la rapidez con la que las aseguradoras pueden subir los precios.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: Cuando las aseguradoras creen que las tarifas permitidas no coinciden con el riesgo, pueden optar por reducir su exposición en su lugar.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Los propietarios que no pueden encontrar cobertura en el mercado estándar pueden recurrir a aseguradoras estatales de último recurso, a menudo llamadas Planes FAIR o programas similares.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: Estos planes pueden ser más caros y ofrecer una protección más limitada.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: Los prestamistas hipotecarios exigen un seguro de propietarios, por lo que perder una póliza no es solo un inconveniente.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: Puede crear un problema de cumplimiento con el préstamo.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los propietarios para reducir la factura

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: No hay forma de escapar por completo de un aumento a nivel de mercado, pero hay pasos prácticos que pueden reducir lo que pagas.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **Compara opciones.** Las tarifas para la misma casa pueden diferir ampliamente entre aseguradoras. Obtén cotizaciones de varias compañías o trabaja con un agente independiente que pueda comparar múltiples proveedores. Haz esto mucho antes de tu fecha de renovación.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Revisa el monto de tu cobertura.** Asegúrate de que el límite de la vivienda refleje los costos de reconstrucción realistas, no el valor de mercado de la casa o el terreno. Asegurar de más desperdicia dinero, mientras que asegurar de menos puede dejarte expuesto después de una pérdida.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Sube tu deducible.** Elegir un deducible más alto puede reducir tu prima, pero hazlo solo si podrías pagar cómodamente esa cantidad de tu bolsillo. Verifica si tu póliza tiene un deducible separado y más alto para viento o granizo.

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **Protege la casa.** Muchas aseguradoras ofrecen descuentos por un techo más nuevo o resistente a impactos, contraventanas para tormentas, cableado y plomería actualizados, sensores de fugas de agua y sistemas de humo o seguridad monitoreados. En áreas de incendios forestales, despejar la vegetación y usar materiales resistentes al fuego puede importar. Pregunta a tu aseguradora exactamente qué mejoras califican.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **Agrupa pólizas.** Combinar la cobertura de hogar y auto con la misma compañía a menudo genera un descuento, aunque debes comparar el precio agrupado con cotizaciones separadas.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **Pregunta por todos los descuentos disponibles.** Estos pueden incluir lealtad, ausencia de reclamos, pago total, facturación sin papel y descuentos para jubilados. La elegibilidad varía según la compañía y el estado.

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **Verifica tus factores relacionados con el crédito donde esté permitido.** En muchos estados, las aseguradoras pueden usar información basada en el crédito para fijar precios. Corregir errores en tu informe de crédito puede ayudar, aunque las reglas difieren según el estado.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **Piénsalo dos veces antes de hacer pequeños reclamos.** Presentar múltiples reclamos pequeños puede subir tus tarifas o afectar la renovación. Considera si es mejor pagar una reparación menor directamente.

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **Comprende las exclusiones de tu póliza.** Las pólizas estándar generalmente no cubren inundaciones o terremotos. Puede haber cobertura separada disponible, y vale la pena saber qué tienes y qué no.

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## Planificación para una era de costos más altos

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: Los propietarios deben tratar el seguro como una línea en el presupuesto del hogar que puede cambiar significativamente de año en año, muy parecido a los impuestos a la propiedad y el mantenimiento.

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: Los compradores en particular deben solicitar una cotización de seguro antes de cerrar la compra de una casa, ya que el costo puede afectar cuánta casa pueden permitirse.

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: Apartar un fondo de emergencia que pueda cubrir un deducible también es prudente.

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: Los debates de política local y estatal continúan sobre cómo equilibrar tarifas asequibles, la solvencia de las aseguradoras y la inversión para hacer que las comunidades sean más resilientes.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: Sea cual sea el resultado, es poco probable que los impulsores subyacentes del riesgo climático, los costos de construcción y los precios de los reaseguros se reviertan rápidamente.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: Una prima en aumento no significa necesariamente que hiciste algo mal o que tu aseguradora te está señalando individualmente.

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: Refleja un sistema mancomunado bajo presión debido a tormentas más costosas, reparaciones más caras y una cobertura de respaldo más costosa.

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: Los propietarios que comparan ofertas, ajustan el tamaño de su cobertura e invierten en mejoras protectoras a menudo pueden reducir el golpe, incluso si no pueden eliminarlo.

segments.tr: Consulta a un profesional de seguros autorizado sobre tu situación específica.*

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## لماذا يرتفع قسط التأمين الخاص بك بينما لم تفعل شيئاً

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## ثلاث قوى تدفع الزيادات

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: عندما ترتفع تكاليف البناء، يرتفع معها المبلغ الذي يجب على شركة التأمين دفعه في حالة الخسارة الكلية أو الجزئية.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. أسعار إعادة التأمين

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: تشتري شركات التأمين نفسها تأميناً، يُعرف بإعادة التأمين، للحماية من السنوات الكارثية.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: قامت شركات إعادة التأمين برفع الأسعار وتشديد الشروط استجابة لخسائر الكوارث الكبيرة، ويتم تمرير هذه التكاليف إلى شركات التأمين الأولية.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن عقود إعادة التأمين غالباً ما يتم تجديدها وفق جدول سنوي محدد، يمكن أن تظهر الزيادات في أسعار المستهلكين مع تأخير.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: قد تسعى شركة التأمين التي تحملت تكاليف أعلى لفترة من الوقت في النهاية إلى زيادات أكبر في الأسعار للحاق بالركب.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: تلعب أسعار الفائدة المرتفعة وتكلفة رأس المال دوراً أيضاً، حيث يجب على شركات التأمين الاحتفاظ باحتياطيات ضد الخسائر المحتملة.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## لماذا يفقد بعض المالكين التغطية

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: زيادات الأسعار هي جزء فقط من القصة.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: في بعض المناطق عالية المخاطر، توقفت شركات التأمين عن كتابة وثائق جديدة، أو رفضت تجديد الوثائق الحالية، أو قللت من عدد المنازل التي تغطيها.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: تقوم الجهات التنظيمية في الولايات عادةً بمراجعة واعتماد تغييرات الأسعار، وفي بعض الولايات تحد عملية الموافقة من مدى سرعة قيام شركات التأمين برفع الأسعار.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: عندما تعتقد شركات التأمين أن الأسعار المسموح بها لا تتطابق مع المخاطر، فقد تختار تقليل تعرضها بدلاً من ذلك.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: قد يلجأ الملاك الذين لا يستطيعون العثور على تغطية في السوق القياسي إلى شركات التأمين المدعومة من الدولة كملاذ أخير، والتي غالباً ما تسمى خطط FAIR أو برامج مماثلة.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون هذه الخطط أكثر تكلفة وقد توفر حماية أضيق.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: يشترط مقرضو الرهن العقاري وجود تغطية لأصحاب المنازل، لذا فإن فقدان وثيقة التأمين ليس مجرد إزعاج.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يخلق مشكلة امتثال مع القرض.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن للمالكين فعله لخفض الفاتورة

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: لا توجد طريقة للهروب تماماً من زيادة على مستوى السوق، ولكن هناك خطوات عملية قد تقلل مما تدفعه.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **تسوق.** يمكن أن تختلف أسعار نفس المنزل اختلافاً كبيراً بين شركات التأمين. احصل على عروض أسعار من عدة شركات أو اعمل مع وكيل مستقل يمكنه مقارنة شركات متعددة. افعل ذلك قبل تاريخ التجديد بوقت كافٍ.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **راجع مبلغ التغطية الخاص بك.** تأكد من أن حد المسكن يعكس تكاليف إعادة البناء الواقعية، وليس القيمة السوقية للمنزل أو الأرض. التأمين الزائد يهدر المال، بينما التأمين الناقص يمكن أن يتركك مكشوفاً بعد وقوع خسارة.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **ارفع مبلغ التحمل الخاص بك.** اختيار مبلغ تحمل أعلى يمكن أن يخفض قسط التأمين الخاص بك، ولكن افعل ذلك فقط إذا كنت تستطيع دفع هذا المبلغ من جيبك الخاص براحة. تحقق مما إذا كانت وثيقتك تحتوي على مبلغ تحمل منفصل وأعلى للرياح أو البرد.

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **حصن المنزل.** تقدم العديد من شركات التأمين خصومات على سقف أحدث أو مقاوم للصدمات، ومصاريع العواصف، وتحديث الأسلاك والسباكة، وأجهزة استشعار تسرب المياه، وأنظمة الدخان أو الأمن المراقبة. في مناطق حرائق الغابات، قد يكون إزالة الغطاء النباتي واستخدام مواد مقاومة للحريق أمراً مهماً. اسأل شركة التأمين الخاصة بك بالضبط عن التحسينات المؤهلة.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **اجمع الوثائق.** غالباً ما يؤدي الجمع بين تغطية المنزل والسيارة مع نفس الشركة إلى خصم، على الرغم من أنه يجب عليك مقارنة السعر المجمع مع عروض الأسعار المنفصلة.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **اسأل عن جميع الخصومات المتاحة.** يمكن أن تشمل هذه خصومات الولاء، وخلو السجل من المطالبات، والدفع بالكامل، والفواتير غير الورقية، وخصومات المتقاعدين. تختلف الأهلية حسب الشركة والولاية.

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من العوامل المتعلقة بائتمانك حيثما كان ذلك مسموحاً به.** في العديد من الولايات، قد تستخدم شركات التأمين المعلومات القائمة على الائتمان في التسعير. يمكن أن يساعد تصحيح الأخطاء في تقرير الائتمان الخاص بك، على الرغم من أن القواعد تختلف حسب الولاية.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **فكر مرتين قبل تقديم مطالبات صغيرة.** يمكن أن يؤدي تقديم مطالبات صغيرة متعددة إلى رفع أسعارك أو التأثير على التجديد. فكر فيما إذا كان من الأفضل دفع تكاليف إصلاح بسيط مباشرة.

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **افهم استثناءات وثيقتك.** لا تغطي الوثائق القياسية عموماً الفيضانات أو الزلازل. قد تكون هناك تغطية منفصلة متاحة، ومن الجدير معرفة ما لديك وما لا تملكه.

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## التخطيط لعصر أعلى تكلفة

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: يجب على أصحاب المنازل التعامل مع التأمين كبند في ميزانية الأسرة يمكن أن يتغير بشكل كبير من سنة إلى أخرى، تماماً مثل الضرائب العقارية والصيانة.

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: يجب على المشترين على وجه الخصوص طلب عرض أسعار للتأمين قبل إتمام شراء منزل، حيث يمكن أن تؤثر التكلفة على مقدار المنزل الذي يمكنهم تحمله.

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: يعد تخصيص صندوق طوارئ يمكنه تغطية مبلغ التحمل أمراً حكيماً أيضاً.

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: تستمر النقاشات السياسية المحلية والولائية حول كيفية موازنة الأسعار المعقولة، وملاءة شركات التأمين، والاستثمار في جعل المجتمعات أكثر مرونة.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: مهما كانت النتيجة، فمن غير المرجح أن تنعكس المحركات الأساسية لمخاطر الطقس وتكاليف البناء وتسعير إعادة التأمين بسرعة.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: ارتفاع القسط لا يعني بالضرورة أنك فعلت شيئاً خاطئاً أو أن شركة التأمين الخاصة بك تستهدفك.

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: إنه يعكس نظاماً مجمعاً تحت ضغط من العواصف الأكثر تكلفة، والإصلاحات الأكثر غلاءً، وتغطية النسخ الاحتياطي الأكثر سعراً.

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: يمكن للمالكين الذين يقارنون العروض، ويعدلون حجم تغطيتهم، ويستثمرون في ترقيات وقائية غالباً تقليل اللدغة، حتى لو لم يتمكنوا من القضاء عليها.
