segments.tr: *هذه المقالة للأغراض المعلوماتية العامة فقط وليست نصيحة تأمينية أو مالية أو قانونية.

segments.src: Policies, regulations and available discounts vary by insurer and state.
segments.tr: تختلف الوثائق واللوائح والخصومات المتاحة حسب شركة التأمين والولاية.

segments.src: Consult a licensed insurance professional about your specific situation.*
segments.tr: استشر متخصص تأمين مرخصاً بشأن وضعك الخاص.*

fr.title: L'assurance habitation est le nouveau choc du coût du logement : pourquoi les primes continuent d'augmenter même pour les propriétaires qui ne déclarent jamais de sinistre

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux propriétaires, le courrier le plus indésirable cette année n'était pas une facture d'impôt ou un relevé hypothécaire.

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: C'était un avis de renouvellement de leur assureur.

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: Les augmentations à deux chiffres sont devenues courantes dans un certain nombre d'États, et dans les régions les plus durement touchées, certains propriétaires ont été informés que leurs polices ne seraient pas renouvelées du tout.

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages qui n'ont jamais déclaré un seul sinistre, ce bond peut sembler déconcertant et injuste.

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: L'explication réside dans le fonctionnement du secteur de l'assurance.

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: La prime d'un propriétaire n'est pas le reflet de l'historique de ce seul ménage.

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'une part d'un pool de risques beaucoup plus vaste, et ce pool est devenu plus coûteux sur plusieurs fronts à la fois.

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi votre prime augmente alors que vous n'avez rien fait

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: L'assurance repose sur la mutualisation.

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: Des milliers de titulaires de polices paient des primes, et l'argent est utilisé pour indemniser les quelques personnes qui subissent des pertes au cours d'une année donnée.

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: Lorsque les pertes au sein du pool augmentent, les primes pour tous les membres de ce pool ont tendance à augmenter également, indépendamment du fait qu'un propriétaire individuel ait déclaré un sinistre ou non.

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: Les assureurs fixent généralement les tarifs par territoire, caractéristiques du logement et modèles de risque plutôt que par le dossier d'un seul client.

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: Si les toits de vos voisins sont endommagés par la grêle, ou si votre région subit une série de tempêtes coûteuses, le coût prévu pour couvrir des maisons comme la vôtre augmente.

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: Votre historique de sinistres vierge peut vous valoir une modeste réduction, mais il ne peut pas compenser un changement à l'échelle du marché.

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## Trois forces à l'origine des augmentations

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. Pertes dues aux tempêtes et aux intempéries

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: Les tempêtes convectives sévères, y compris la grêle et les vents violents, sont devenues une source majeure de pertes assurées dans de nombreuses régions du pays, aux côtés des ouragans, des incendies de forêt et des inondations dans les zones les plus exposées.

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: Les assureurs ont signalé plusieurs années au cours desquelles les indemnisations ont dépassé les primes collectées pour les assurances habitation dans certains États.

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: Même des événements modérés s'additionnent lorsqu'ils se produisent fréquemment sur de nombreuses propriétés.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. Coûts de reconstruction plus élevés

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: L'assurance habitation est généralement conçue pour payer la réparation ou la reconstruction d'une maison, et non pour l'acheter à son prix du marché.

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: Le coût de la reconstruction dépend du bois d'œuvre, des matériaux de toiture, des appareils électroménagers, de la main-d'œuvre et des permis, qui ont tous fortement augmenté ces dernières années.

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: Lorsque les coûts de construction grimpent, le montant qu'un assureur doit payer en cas de perte totale ou partielle grimpe avec eux.

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: De nombreuses polices sont ajustées automatiquement pour cela, ce qui signifie que la limite de couverture et la prime peuvent augmenter ensemble même si la maison elle-même n'a pas changé.

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: Les pénuries de main-d'œuvre dans les métiers du bâtiment et les dépenses liées au respect des codes du bâtiment mis à jour ajoutent une pression supplémentaire.

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: Une réparation qui coûtait un certain montant il y a quelques années peut coûter nettement plus cher aujourd'hui.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. Prix de la réassurance

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: Les assureurs eux-mêmes souscrivent une assurance, appelée réassurance, pour se protéger contre les années catastrophiques.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: Les réassureurs ont augmenté leurs prix et durci leurs conditions en réponse aux pertes importantes dues aux catastrophes, et ces coûts sont répercutés sur les assureurs primaires.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: Comme les contrats de réassurance sont souvent renouvelés selon un calendrier annuel fixe, les augmentations peuvent apparaître dans les tarifs des consommateurs avec un certain retard.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: Un assureur qui a absorbé des coûts plus élevés pendant un certain temps peut éventuellement chercher à augmenter ses tarifs pour rattraper son retard.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: La hausse des taux d'intérêt et le coût du capital jouent également un rôle, car les assureurs doivent constituer des réserves contre les pertes potentielles.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi certains propriétaires perdent leur couverture

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: Les augmentations de tarifs ne sont qu'une partie du problème.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: Dans certaines zones à haut risque, les assureurs ont cessé de souscrire de nouvelles polices, ont refusé de renouveler les polices existantes ou ont réduit le nombre de maisons qu'ils couvrent.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: Les régulateurs des États examinent et approuvent généralement les changements de tarifs, et dans certains États, le processus d'approbation limite la rapidité avec laquelle les assureurs peuvent augmenter leurs prix.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: Lorsque les assureurs estiment que les tarifs autorisés ne correspondent pas au risque, ils peuvent choisir de réduire leur exposition à la place.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires qui ne peuvent pas trouver de couverture sur le marché standard peuvent se tourner vers des assureurs de dernier recours soutenus par l'État, souvent appelés FAIR Plans ou programmes similaires.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: Ces plans peuvent être plus coûteux et offrir une protection plus limitée.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: Les prêteurs hypothécaires exigent une assurance habitation, donc perdre une police n'est pas seulement un inconvénient.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: Cela peut créer un problème de conformité avec le prêt.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## Ce que les propriétaires peuvent faire pour réduire la facture

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: Il n'y a aucun moyen d'échapper complètement à une augmentation à l'échelle du marché, mais il existe des mesures pratiques qui peuvent réduire ce que vous payez.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **Comparez les offres.** Les tarifs pour une même maison peuvent varier considérablement d'un assureur à l'autre. Obtenez des devis de plusieurs entreprises ou travaillez avec un agent indépendant qui peut comparer plusieurs assureurs. Faites cela bien avant votre date de renouvellement.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Examinez le montant de votre couverture.** Assurez-vous que la limite de l'habitation reflète les coûts de reconstruction réalistes, et non la valeur marchande de la maison ou du terrain. Sur-assurer est un gaspillage d'argent, tandis que sous-assurer peut vous laisser exposé après un sinistre.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Augmentez votre franchise.** Choisir une franchise plus élevée peut réduire votre prime, mais ne le faites que si vous pouvez confortablement payer ce montant de votre poche. Vérifiez si votre police comporte une franchise distincte et plus élevée pour le vent ou la grêle.

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **Renforcez la maison.** De nombreux assureurs offrent des réductions pour un toit plus récent ou résistant aux chocs, des volets anti-tempête, une mise à jour du câblage et de la plomberie, des capteurs de fuite d'eau et des systèmes de fumée ou de sécurité surveillés. Dans les zones sujettes aux incendies de forêt, le débroussaillage et l'utilisation de matériaux ignifuges peuvent être importants. Demandez à votre assureur quelles améliorations sont éligibles.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **Regroupez vos polices.** Combiner l'assurance habitation et auto auprès de la même compagnie permet souvent d'obtenir une réduction, bien que vous deviez comparer le prix groupé avec des devis séparés.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **Renseignez-vous sur toutes les réductions disponibles.** Celles-ci peuvent inclure des réductions pour fidélité, absence de sinistre, paiement intégral, facturation sans papier et pour les retraités. L'éligibilité varie selon l'entreprise et l'État.

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez vos facteurs liés au crédit là où c'est autorisé.** Dans de nombreux États, les assureurs peuvent utiliser des informations basées sur le crédit pour la tarification. Corriger les erreurs dans votre rapport de crédit peut aider, bien que les règles diffèrent selon l'État.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **Réfléchissez à deux fois avant de déclarer de petits sinistres.** Déclarer plusieurs petits sinistres peut augmenter vos tarifs ou affecter le renouvellement. Considérez si une réparation mineure est mieux payée directement.

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **Comprenez les exclusions de votre police.** Les polices standard ne couvrent généralement pas les inondations ou les tremblements de terre. Une couverture séparée peut être disponible, et il vaut la peine de savoir ce que vous avez et ce que vous n'avez pas.

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## Planifier pour une ère de coûts plus élevés

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires devraient traiter l'assurance comme une ligne du budget des ménages qui peut changer considérablement d'année en année, tout comme les impôts fonciers et l'entretien.

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: Les acheteurs en particulier devraient demander un devis d'assurance avant de conclure l'achat d'une maison, car le coût peut affecter le budget immobilier qu'ils peuvent se permettre.

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: Mettre de côté un fonds d'urgence pouvant couvrir une franchise est également prudent.

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: Les débats politiques locaux et nationaux se poursuivent sur la manière d'équilibrer des tarifs abordables, la solvabilité des assureurs et l'investissement pour rendre les communautés plus résilientes.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: Quel que soit le résultat, les facteurs sous-jacents du risque météorologique, des coûts de construction et de la tarisation de la réassurance ne risquent pas de s'inverser rapidement.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: Une prime en hausse ne signifie pas nécessairement que vous avez fait quelque chose de mal ou que votre assureur vous prend pour cible.

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: Cela reflète un système mutualisé sous tension en raison de tempêtes plus coûteuses, de réparations plus onéreuses et d'une couverture de secours plus chère.

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires qui comparent les offres, ajustent leur couverture et investissent dans des améliorations protectrices peuvent souvent réduire la douleur, même s'ils ne peuvent pas l'éliminer.

pt.title: O Seguro Residencial é o Novo Choque de Custo de Habitação: Por que os Prêmios Continuam Subindo Mesmo para Proprietários que Nunca Fizeram uma Reivindicação

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: Para muitos proprietários, a correspondência mais indesejada deste ano não foi uma conta de imposto ou um extrato de hipoteca.

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: Foi um aviso de renovação da seguradora.

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: Aumentos de dois dígitos tornaram-se comuns em vários estados e, nas regiões mais atingidas, alguns proprietários foram informados de que suas apólices não seriam renovadas de forma alguma.

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: Para famílias que nunca fizeram uma única reivindicação, o salto pode parecer desconcertante e injusto.

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: A explicação reside em como o negócio de seguros funciona.

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: O prêmio de um proprietário não é um reflexo apenas do histórico daquela família.

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: É uma parte de um conjunto muito maior de risco, e esse conjunto tornou-se mais caro em várias frentes ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## Por que seu prêmio aumenta quando você não fez nada

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: O seguro é construído com base no agrupamento.

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: Milhares de segurados pagam prêmios, e o dinheiro é usado para pagar as reivindicações dos poucos que sofrem perdas em um determinado ano.

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: Quando as perdas em todo o grupo aumentam, os prêmios para todos nesse grupo tendem a aumentar também, independentemente de um proprietário individual ter feito uma reivindicação ou não.

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: As seguradoras normalmente definem as taxas por território, características da casa e modelos de risco, em vez do histórico de um único cliente.

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: Se os telhados dos seus vizinhos forem danificados por granizo, ou se sua região sofrer uma série de tempestades dispendiosas, o custo esperado para cobrir casas como a sua aumenta.

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: Seu histórico limpo de reivindicações pode garantir um desconto modesto, mas não pode compensar uma mudança em todo o mercado.

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## Três forças impulsionando os aumentos

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. Tempestades e perdas climáticas

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: Tempestades convectivas severas, incluindo granizo e ventos fortes, tornaram-se uma grande fonte de perdas seguradas em muitas partes do país, juntamente com furacões, incêndios florestais e inundações em áreas mais expostas.

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: As seguradoras relataram vários anos em que os pagamentos excederam os prêmios coletados para linhas residenciais em alguns estados.

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: Mesmo eventos moderados se acumulam quando ocorrem com frequência em muitas propriedades.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. Custos de reconstrução mais altos

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: O seguro residencial é geralmente projetado para pagar o reparo ou a reconstrução de uma casa, não para comprá-la pelo seu preço de mercado.

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: O custo para reconstruir depende de madeira, materiais de cobertura, eletrodomésticos, mão de obra e licenciamento, todos os quais aumentaram drasticamente nos últimos anos.

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: Quando os custos de construção sobem, o valor que uma seguradora deve pagar em uma perda total ou parcial sobe junto com eles.

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: Muitas apólices são ajustadas automaticamente para isso, o que significa que o limite de cobertura e o prêmio podem aumentar juntos, mesmo que a casa em si não tenha mudado.

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: A escassez de mão de obra nos setores de construção e a despesa de atender aos códigos de construção atualizados adicionam mais pressão.

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: Um reparo que custava um certo valor alguns anos atrás pode custar visivelmente mais hoje.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. Preços de resseguro

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: As próprias seguradoras compram seguros, conhecidos como resseguro, para se proteger contra anos catastróficos.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: Os resseguradores aumentaram os preços e endureceram os termos em resposta a grandes perdas por desastres, e esses custos são repassados às seguradoras primárias.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: Como os contratos de resseguro geralmente são renovados em um cronograma anual definido, os aumentos podem aparecer nas taxas do consumidor com um atraso.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: Uma seguradora que absorveu custos mais altos por um tempo pode eventualmente buscar aumentos de taxa maiores para compensar.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: Taxas de juros mais altas e o custo do capital também desempenham um papel, já que as seguradoras devem manter reservas contra possíveis perdas.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## Por que alguns proprietários estão perdendo a cobertura

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: Os aumentos de taxa são apenas parte da história.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: Em algumas áreas de alto risco, as seguradoras pararam de emitir novas apólices, recusaram-se a renovar as existentes ou reduziram o número de casas que cobrem.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: Os reguladores estaduais geralmente revisam e aprovam as mudanças nas taxas e, em alguns estados, o processo de aprovação limita a rapidez com que as seguradoras podem aumentar os preços.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: Quando as seguradoras acreditam que as taxas permitidas não correspondem ao risco, elas podem optar por reduzir sua exposição.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Proprietários que não conseguem encontrar cobertura no mercado padrão podem recorrer a seguradoras de última instância apoiadas pelo estado, frequentemente chamadas de Planos FAIR ou programas semelhantes.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: Esses planos podem ser mais caros e oferecer proteção mais restrita.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: Os credores hipotecários exigem cobertura residencial, portanto, perder uma apólice não é apenas um inconveniente.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: Pode criar um problema de conformidade com o empréstimo.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## O que os proprietários podem fazer para reduzir a conta

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: Não há como escapar totalmente de um aumento em todo o mercado, mas existem passos práticos que podem reduzir o que você paga.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **Pesquise.** As taxas para a mesma casa podem diferir amplamente entre as seguradoras. Obtenha cotações de várias empresas ou trabalhe com um agente independente que possa comparar várias operadoras. Faça isso bem antes da data de renovação.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Revise o valor da sua cobertura.** Certifique-se de que o limite da habitação reflita os custos reais de reconstrução, não o valor de mercado da casa ou do terreno. Segurar demais desperdiça dinheiro, enquanto segurar de menos pode deixá-lo exposto após uma perda.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Aumente sua franquia.** Escolher uma franquia mais alta pode reduzir seu prêmio, mas faça isso apenas se puder pagar confortavelmente esse valor do próprio bolso. Verifique se sua apólice tem uma franquia separada e mais alta para vento ou granizo.

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **Reforce a casa.** Muitas seguradoras oferecem descontos para um telhado mais novo ou resistente a impactos, persianas contra tempestades, fiação e encanamento atualizados, sensores de vazamento de água e sistemas monitorados de fumaça ou segurança. Em áreas de incêndios florestais, limpar a vegetação e usar materiais resistentes ao fogo pode ser importante. Pergunte à sua seguradora exatamente quais melhorias se qualificam.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **Combine apólices.** Combinar a cobertura residencial e automotiva com a mesma empresa geralmente gera um desconto, embora você deva comparar o preço combinado com cotações separadas.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **Pergunte sobre todos os descontos disponíveis.** Eles podem incluir descontos por fidelidade, ausência de reivindicações, pagamento integral, faturamento sem papel e para aposentados. A elegibilidade varia de acordo com a empresa e o estado.

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **Verifique seus fatores relacionados ao crédito onde permitido.** Em muitos estados, as seguradoras podem usar informações baseadas em crédito na precificação. Corrigir erros em seu relatório de crédito pode ajudar, embora as regras difiram por estado.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **Pense duas vezes antes de pequenas reivindicações.** Fazer várias pequenas reivindicações pode aumentar suas taxas ou afetar a renovação. Considere se é melhor pagar um pequeno reparo diretamente.

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **Entenda as exclusões da sua apólice.** As apólices padrão geralmente não cobrem inundações ou terremotos. Cobertura separada pode estar disponível, e vale a pena saber o que você tem e o que não tem.

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## Planejando para uma era de custos mais altos

segments.tr: Os proprietários devem tratar o seguro como uma linha no orçamento doméstico que pode mudar significativamente de ano para ano, assim como impostos prediais e manutenção.

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: Os compradores, em particular, devem solicitar uma cotação de seguro antes de fechar a compra de uma casa, já que o custo pode afetar quanto de casa eles podem pagar.

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: Reservar um fundo de emergência que possa cobrir uma franquia também é prudente.

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: Os debates sobre políticas locais e estaduais continuam sobre como equilibrar taxas acessíveis, solvência das seguradoras e investimento em tornar as comunidades mais resilientes.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: Independentemente do resultado, os impulsionadores subjacentes do risco climático, custos de construção e precificação de resseguro dificilmente serão revertidos rapidamente.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: Um prêmio crescente não significa necessariamente que você fez algo errado ou que sua seguradora está escolhendo você.

segments.tr: Reflete um sistema agrupado sob pressão de tempestades mais caras, reparos mais caros e cobertura de backup mais cara.

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: Proprietários que comparam ofertas, ajustam sua cobertura e investem em melhorias de proteção muitas vezes podem reduzir o impacto, mesmo que não consigam eliminá-lo.

segments.tr: ### 1. Kerugian akibat badai dan cuaca

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: Badai konvektif yang parah, termasuk hujan es dan angin kencang, telah menjadi sumber utama kerugian asuransi di banyak bagian negara, di samping badai, kebakaran hutan, dan banjir di daerah yang lebih rentan.

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi telah melaporkan beberapa tahun di mana pembayaran melebihi premi yang dikumpulkan untuk lini pemilik rumah di beberapa negara bagian.

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: Bahkan peristiwa sedang pun akan terakumulasi ketika sering terjadi di banyak properti.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. Biaya pembangunan kembali yang lebih tinggi

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: Asuransi pemilik rumah umumnya dirancang untuk membayar perbaikan atau pembangunan kembali rumah, bukan untuk membelinya dengan harga pasar.

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: Biaya untuk membangun kembali bergantung pada kayu, bahan atap, peralatan, tenaga kerja, dan perizinan, yang semuanya naik tajam dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: Ketika biaya konstruksi naik, jumlah yang harus dibayarkan perusahaan asuransi atas kerugian total atau sebagian juga ikut naik.

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: Banyak polis disesuaikan secara otomatis untuk hal ini, yang berarti batas pertanggungan dan premi dapat naik bersamaan meskipun rumah itu sendiri tidak berubah.

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: Kekurangan tenaga kerja di bidang bangunan dan biaya untuk memenuhi kode bangunan yang diperbarui menambah tekanan lebih lanjut.

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: Perbaikan yang memakan biaya tertentu beberapa tahun lalu mungkin jauh lebih mahal hari ini.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. Harga reasuransi

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi sendiri membeli asuransi, yang dikenal sebagai reasuransi, untuk melindungi dari tahun-tahun bencana.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: Perusahaan reasuransi telah menaikkan harga dan memperketat persyaratan sebagai tanggapan atas kerugian bencana yang besar, dan biaya tersebut dibebankan kepada perusahaan asuransi utama.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: Karena kontrak reasuransi sering diperbarui sesuai jadwal tahunan yang ditetapkan, kenaikan dapat muncul pada tarif konsumen dengan penundaan.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi yang menyerap biaya lebih tinggi untuk sementara waktu mungkin pada akhirnya akan mencari kenaikan tarif yang lebih besar untuk mengejar ketertinggalan.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi dan biaya modal juga berperan, karena perusahaan asuransi harus menahan cadangan terhadap potensi kerugian.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## Mengapa beberapa pemilik kehilangan pertanggungan

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: Kenaikan tarif hanyalah sebagian dari cerita.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: Di beberapa daerah berisiko tinggi, perusahaan asuransi telah berhenti menerbitkan polis baru, menolak untuk memperbarui polis yang ada, atau mengurangi jumlah rumah yang mereka tanggung.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: Regulator negara bagian umumnya meninjau dan menyetujui perubahan tarif, dan di beberapa negara bagian, proses persetujuan membatasi seberapa cepat perusahaan asuransi dapat menaikkan harga.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: Ketika perusahaan asuransi yakin bahwa tarif yang diizinkan tidak sesuai dengan risiko, mereka mungkin memilih untuk mengurangi eksposur mereka sebagai gantinya.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Pemilik yang tidak dapat menemukan pertanggungan di pasar standar mungkin beralih ke perusahaan asuransi pilihan terakhir yang didukung negara, yang sering disebut FAIR Plans atau program serupa.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: Rencana ini bisa lebih mahal dan mungkin menawarkan perlindungan yang lebih sempit.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: Pemberi pinjaman hipotek mewajibkan pertanggungan pemilik rumah, jadi kehilangan polis bukan sekadar ketidaknyamanan.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: Ini dapat menciptakan masalah kepatuhan dengan pinjaman.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dapat dilakukan pemilik untuk menurunkan tagihan

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: Tidak ada cara untuk sepenuhnya menghindari kenaikan di seluruh pasar, tetapi ada langkah-langkah praktis yang dapat mengurangi apa yang Anda bayar.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan.** Tarif untuk rumah yang sama bisa sangat berbeda antar perusahaan asuransi. Dapatkan penawaran dari beberapa perusahaan atau bekerja sama dengan agen independen yang dapat membandingkan beberapa penyedia. Lakukan ini jauh sebelum tanggal perpanjangan Anda.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **Tinjau jumlah pertanggungan Anda.** Pastikan batas hunian mencerminkan biaya pembangunan kembali yang realistis, bukan nilai pasar rumah atau tanah. Asuransi berlebih membuang-buang uang, sementara asuransi kurang dapat membuat Anda rentan setelah kerugian.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Naikkan deduktibel Anda.** Memilih deduktibel yang lebih tinggi dapat menurunkan premi Anda, tetapi lakukan hanya jika Anda dapat dengan nyaman membayar jumlah tersebut dari kantong sendiri. Periksa apakah polis Anda memiliki deduktibel terpisah yang lebih tinggi untuk angin atau hujan es.

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **Perkuat rumah.** Banyak perusahaan asuransi menawarkan diskon untuk atap yang lebih baru atau tahan benturan, penutup badai, kabel dan pipa yang diperbarui, sensor kebocoran air, serta sistem asap atau keamanan yang dipantau. Di daerah kebakaran hutan, membersihkan vegetasi dan menggunakan bahan tahan api mungkin penting. Tanyakan kepada perusahaan asuransi Anda perbaikan mana yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **Gabungkan polis.** Menggabungkan pertanggungan rumah dan mobil dengan perusahaan yang sama sering kali memberikan diskon, meskipun Anda harus membandingkan harga paket dengan penawaran terpisah.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **Tanyakan tentang semua diskon yang tersedia.** Ini dapat mencakup diskon loyalitas, bebas klaim, pembayaran penuh, penagihan tanpa kertas, dan pensiunan. Kelayakan bervariasi menurut perusahaan dan negara bagian.

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **Periksa faktor terkait kredit Anda jika diizinkan.** Di banyak negara bagian, perusahaan asuransi dapat menggunakan informasi berbasis kredit dalam penetapan harga. Memperbaiki kesalahan dalam laporan kredit Anda dapat membantu, meskipun aturannya berbeda menurut negara bagian.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **Berpikir dua kali sebelum mengajukan klaim kecil.** Mengajukan beberapa klaim kecil dapat menaikkan tarif Anda atau memengaruhi perpanjangan. Pertimbangkan apakah perbaikan kecil lebih baik dibayar secara langsung.

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **Pahami pengecualian polis Anda.** Polis standar umumnya tidak mencakup banjir atau gempa bumi. Pertanggungan terpisah mungkin tersedia, dan ada baiknya mengetahui apa yang Anda miliki dan tidak miliki.

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## Merencanakan era biaya yang lebih tinggi

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: Pemilik rumah harus memperlakukan asuransi sebagai pos dalam anggaran rumah tangga yang dapat berubah secara signifikan dari tahun ke tahun, seperti pajak properti dan pemeliharaan.

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: Pembeli khususnya harus meminta penawaran asuransi sebelum menyelesaikan pembelian rumah, karena biayanya dapat memengaruhi seberapa besar rumah yang mampu mereka beli.

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: Menyisihkan dana darurat yang dapat menutupi deduktibel juga bijaksana.

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: Perdebatan kebijakan lokal dan negara bagian terus berlanjut mengenai cara menyeimbangkan tarif yang terjangkau, solvabilitas perusahaan asuransi, dan investasi dalam membuat komunitas lebih tangguh.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: Apa pun hasilnya, pendorong mendasar dari risiko cuaca, biaya konstruksi, dan harga reasuransi kemungkinan tidak akan berbalik dengan cepat.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: Premi yang naik tidak selalu berarti Anda melakukan kesalahan atau bahwa perusahaan asuransi Anda memilih Anda secara khusus.

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: Ini mencerminkan sistem gabungan yang berada di bawah tekanan dari badai yang lebih merugikan, perbaikan yang lebih mahal, dan pertanggungan cadangan yang lebih mahal.

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: Pemilik yang membandingkan penawaran, menyesuaikan ukuran pertanggungan mereka, dan berinvestasi dalam peningkatan perlindungan sering kali dapat mengurangi dampaknya, meskipun mereka tidak dapat menghilangkannya.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat asuransi, keuangan, atau hukum.

segments.src: Policies, regulations and available discounts vary by insurer and state.
segments.tr: Polis, peraturan, dan diskon yang tersedia bervariasi menurut perusahaan asuransi dan negara bagian.

segments.src: Consult a licensed insurance professional about your specific situation.*
segments.tr: Konsultasikan dengan profesional asuransi berlisensi mengenai situasi spesifik Anda.*

ja.title: 住宅保険が新たな住宅コストの衝撃に：保険金を一度も請求したことがない所有者でも保険料が上がり続ける理由

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: 多くの住宅所有者にとって、今年最も受け取りたくなかった郵便物は、税金の請求書や住宅ローンの明細書ではありませんでした。

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: それは、保険会社からの更新通知でした。

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: 多くの州で2桁の引き上げが一般的になっており、最も被害の大きい地域では、保険契約が一切更新されないと告げられた所有者もいます。

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: 一度も保険金を請求したことがない世帯にとって、この急騰は不可解で不公平に感じられるかもしれません。

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: その理由は、保険事業の仕組みにあります。

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: 住宅所有者の保険料は、その世帯自身の履歴だけを反映したものではありません。

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: それは、より大きなリスクプールの一部であり、そのプールはいくつかの面で同時にコストが増大しているのです。

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## 何もしていないのになぜ保険料が上がるのか

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: 保険はプーリング（共同化）に基づいています。

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: 数千人の契約者が保険料を支払い、その資金は、その年に損失を被った少数の人々の保険金を支払うために使われます。

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: プール全体の損失が増加すると、個々の所有者が保険金を請求したかどうかにかかわらず、そのプール内の全員の保険料も上昇する傾向があります。

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: 保険会社は通常、個々の顧客の記録ではなく、地域、住宅の特性、リスクモデルに基づいて料率を設定します。

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: 近所の屋根が雹（ひょう）で損傷したり、お住まいの地域で高額な損害を伴う嵐が続いたりすると、あなたのような住宅を補償するための予想コストが上昇します。

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: あなたのクリーンな請求履歴はわずかな割引につながるかもしれませんが、市場全体の変動を相殺することはできません。

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## 値上げを牽引する3つの要因

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. 嵐と気象による損失

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: 雹や強風を伴う激しい対流性嵐は、ハリケーン、山火事、そしてよりリスクの高い地域での洪水と並び、国内の多くの地域で保険金支払いの主な原因となっています。

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: 保険会社は、一部の州において、住宅保険部門で徴収した保険料を支払額が上回る年が数年続いたと報告しています。

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: 中程度の規模の出来事であっても、多くの物件で頻繁に発生すれば、積み重なって大きな損失となります。

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. 再建コストの上昇

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: 住宅保険は一般的に、住宅を市場価格で購入するためではなく、修理または再建するための費用を支払うように設計されています。

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 再建費用は、木材、屋根材、家電製品、人件費、許認可費用に左右されますが、これらはすべて近年急激に上昇しています。

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: 建設コストが上昇すると、全損または分損の際に保険会社が支払わなければならない金額もそれに伴って上昇します。

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: 多くの保険契約ではこの点について自動的に調整が行われるため、住宅自体に変更がなくても、補償限度額と保険料が同時に上昇する可能性があります。

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: 建設業界における人手不足や、最新の建築基準を満たすための費用が、さらなる圧力となっています。

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: 数年前に一定の費用で済んだ修理が、今日では著しく高額になる可能性があります。

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. 再保険価格

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: 保険会社自身も、壊滅的な被害が出る年に備えて「再保険」と呼ばれる保険に加入しています。

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: 再保険会社は大規模な災害損失を受けて価格を引き上げ、条件を厳格化しており、そのコストは元受保険会社に転嫁されています。

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: 再保険契約は多くの場合、決まった年間スケジュールで更新されるため、値上げが消費者の料率に反映されるまでにはタイムラグが生じることがあります。

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: 一時的にコスト増を吸収していた保険会社も、最終的には追いつくために大幅な料率引き上げを求める可能性があります。

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: 保険会社は潜在的な損失に備えて準備金を保持しなければならないため、金利の上昇や資本コストも影響しています。

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## 一部の所有者が補償を失う理由

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: 料率の引き上げは、状況の一部に過ぎません。

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: 一部の高リスク地域では、保険会社が新規契約の引き受けを停止したり、既存契約の更新を拒否したり、補償する住宅の数を減らしたりしています。

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: 州の規制当局は通常、料率の変更を審査・承認しますが、一部の州では、承認プロセスによって保険会社が価格を引き上げられるスピードが制限されています。

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: 保険会社が、許可された料率がリスクに見合っていないと判断した場合、代わりにリスクへのエクスポージャー（引き受け）を減らすことを選択する可能性があります。

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: 標準的な市場で補償を見つけられない所有者は、FAIRプランや同様のプログラムと呼ばれる、州が支援する最後の手段としての保険会社に頼らざるを得なくなる場合があります。

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: これらのプランはより高額になる可能性があり、補償範囲が狭い場合もあります。

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: 住宅ローン貸し手は住宅保険への加入を義務付けているため、保険契約を失うことは単なる不便ではありません。

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: それらローン契約上のコンプライアンス問題を引き起こす可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## 所有者が保険料を下げるためにできること

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: 市場全体の値上げを完全に回避する方法はありませんが、支払額を減らすために実践できるステップはあります。

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **比較検討する。** 同じ住宅でも、保険会社によって料率が大きく異なる場合があります。複数の会社から見積もりを取るか、複数の保険会社を比較できる独立系代理店に相談してください。更新日のかなり前に行うのがポイントです。

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.
segments.tr: - **補償額を見直す。** 住宅や土地の市場価値ではなく、現実的な再建コストを反映した補償限度額になっているか確認してください。過剰な保険は無駄であり、過少な保険は損失発生時にリスクを露呈させることになります。

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **免責金額を引き上げる。** 免責金額（自己負担額）を高く設定すると保険料を下げることができますが、その金額を余裕を持って自己負担できる場合にのみ行ってください。風災や雹災に対して、別途高い免責金額が設定されていないか確認してください。

segments.src: - **Harden the home.** Many insurers offer discounts for a newer or impact-resistant roof, storm shutters, updated wiring and plumbing, water-leak sensors, and monitored smoke or security systems. In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.
segments.tr: - **住宅を強化する。** 多くの保険会社は、新しい屋根や耐衝撃性の屋根、雨戸、配線や配管の更新、漏水センサー、監視付きの煙探知機やセキュリティシステムに対して割引を提供しています。山火事が発生しやすい地域では、植生の除去や耐火素材の使用が重要になる場合があります。どの改善が割引の対象になるか、保険会社に具体的に問い合わせてください。

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **保険をまとめる。** 住宅保険と自動車保険を同じ会社で組み合わせると割引が適用されることが多いですが、セット価格と個別の見積もりを比較することをお勧めします。

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **利用可能なすべての割引について尋ねる。** ロイヤリティ割引、無事故割引、一括払い割引、ペーパーレス請求割引、退職者割引などがあります。対象条件は会社や州によって異なります。

segments.src: - **Check your credit-related factors where permitted.** In many states insurers may use credit-based information in pricing. Correcting errors in your credit report can help, although rules differ by state.
segments.tr: - **許可されている場合は、信用関連の要素を確認する。** 多くの州では、保険会社が価格設定に信用情報を利用することがあります。信用報告書の誤りを修正することは役立つ可能性がありますが、ルールは州によって異なります。

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **少額の請求は慎重に検討する。** 少額の請求を繰り返すと、料率が上がったり、更新に影響したりする可能性があります。軽微な修理であれば、直接支払った方が良いかどうかを検討してください。

segments.src: - **Understand your policy's exclusions.** Standard policies generally do not cover flooding or earthquakes. Separate coverage may be available, and it is worth knowing what you do and do not have.
segments.tr: - **保険契約の免責事項を理解する。** 標準的な保険契約では、通常、洪水や地震は補償されません。別途補償が用意されている場合があるため、何が補償され、何が補償されないのかを知っておく価値があります。

segments.src: ## Planning for a higher-cost era
segments.tr: ## 高コスト時代への備え

segments.src: Homeowners should treat insurance as a line in the household budget that can change significantly from year to year, much like property taxes and maintenance.
segments.tr: 住宅所有者は、保険を固定資産税やメンテナンス費用と同様に、年ごとに大きく変動する可能性がある家計の項目として扱うべきです。

segments.src: Buyers in particular should request an insurance quote before closing on a home, since the cost can affect how much house they can afford.
segments.tr: 特に住宅購入者は、保険料が購入可能な住宅の価格に影響を与える可能性があるため、契約を締結する前に保険の見積もりを依頼すべきです。

segments.src: Setting aside an emergency fund that can cover a deductible is also prudent.
segments.tr: 免責金額をカバーできる緊急資金を確保しておくことも賢明です。

segments.src: Local and state policy debates continue over how to balance affordable rates, insurer solvency and investment in making communities more resilient.
segments.tr: 手頃な料率、保険会社の支払い能力、そして地域社会の回復力を高めるための投資をどのようにバランスさせるかについて、地方および州レベルでの政策議論が続いています。

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the underlying drivers of weather risk, construction costs and reinsurance pricing are unlikely to reverse quickly.
segments.tr: どのような結果になるにせよ、気象リスク、建設コスト、再保険価格といった根本的な要因がすぐに好転する可能性は低いでしょう。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A rising premium does not necessarily mean you did something wrong or that your insurer is singling you out.
segments.tr: 保険料の上昇は、必ずしもあなたが何か間違ったことをしたとか、保険会社があなたを標的にしていることを意味するわけではありません。

segments.src: It reflects a pooled system under strain from costlier storms, more expensive repairs and pricier backup coverage.
segments.tr: それは、より激しい嵐、より高額な修理費、そしてより高価なバックアップ補償（再保険）によって圧迫されている共同化システムの現状を反映しています。

segments.src: Owners who compare offers, right-size their coverage and invest in protective upgrades can often reduce the sting, even if they cannot eliminate it.
segments.tr: 複数の提案を比較し、補償内容を適正化し、保護のためのアップグレードに投資する所有者は、完全に解消することはできなくても、その痛みを軽減できることがよくあります。

segments.tr: 保険契約、規制、および利用可能な割引は、保険会社や州によって異なります。

de.title: Wohngebäudeversicherung ist der neue Schock bei den Wohnkosten: Warum die Prämien selbst für Eigentümer steigen, die nie einen Schaden melden

segments.src: For many homeowners, the most unwelcome piece of mail this year was not a tax bill or a mortgage statement.
segments.tr: Für viele Hausbesitzer war die unangenehmste Post in diesem Jahr keine Steuerrechnung oder Hypothekenabrechnung.

segments.src: It was a renewal notice from their insurer.
segments.tr: Es war eine Erneuerungsmitteilung ihres Versicherers.

segments.src: Double-digit increases have become common in a number of states, and in the hardest-hit regions some owners have been told their policies will not be renewed at all.
segments.tr: Zweistellige Erhöhungen sind in einer Reihe von Bundesstaaten zur Normalität geworden, und in den am stärksten betroffenen Regionen wurde einigen Eigentümern mitgeteilt, dass ihre Policen überhaupt nicht verlängert werden.

segments.src: For households that have never filed a single claim, the jump can feel baffling and unfair.
segments.tr: Für Haushalte, die noch nie einen einzigen Schaden gemeldet haben, kann der Sprung verwirrend und unfair erscheinen.

segments.src: The explanation lies in how the insurance business works.
segments.tr: Die Erklärung liegt in der Funktionsweise des Versicherungsgeschäfts.

segments.src: A homeowner's premium is not a reflection of that household's own history alone.
segments.tr: Die Prämie eines Hausbesitzers ist nicht allein ein Spiegelbild der eigenen Historie dieses Haushalts.

segments.src: It is a share of a much larger pool of risk, and that pool has grown more expensive on several fronts at once.
segments.tr: Sie ist ein Anteil an einem viel größeren Risikopool, und dieser Pool ist an mehreren Fronten gleichzeitig teurer geworden.

segments.src: ## Why your premium rises when you did nothing
segments.tr: ## Warum Ihre Prämie steigt, obwohl Sie nichts getan haben

segments.src: Insurance is built on pooling.
segments.tr: Versicherungen basieren auf dem Prinzip der Risikogemeinschaft.

segments.src: Thousands of policyholders pay premiums, and the money is used to pay the claims of the few who suffer losses in a given year.
segments.tr: Tausende von Versicherungsnehmern zahlen Prämien, und das Geld wird verwendet, um die Schäden der wenigen zu begleichen, die in einem bestimmten Jahr Verluste erleiden.

segments.src: When losses across the pool rise, premiums for everyone in that pool tend to rise too, regardless of whether an individual owner filed a claim.
segments.tr: Wenn die Schäden im gesamten Pool steigen, neigen auch die Prämien für alle in diesem Pool dazu, zu steigen, unabhängig davon, ob ein einzelner Eigentümer einen Schaden gemeldet hat.

segments.src: Insurers typically set rates by territory, home characteristics and risk models rather than by a single customer's record.
segments.tr: Versicherer legen die Tarife in der Regel nach Gebiet, Hauseigenschaften und Risikomodellen fest und nicht nach der Historie eines einzelnen Kunden.

segments.src: If your neighbors' roofs are damaged by hail, or your region experiences a string of costly storms, the expected cost of covering homes like yours goes up.
segments.tr: Wenn die Dächer Ihrer Nachbarn durch Hagel beschädigt werden oder Ihre Region eine Reihe kostspieliger Stürme erlebt, steigen die erwarteten Kosten für die Absicherung von Häusern wie Ihrem.

segments.src: Your clean claims history may earn a modest discount, but it cannot offset a market-wide shift.
segments.tr: Ihre schadenfreie Historie mag Ihnen einen bescheidenen Rabatt einbringen, aber sie kann eine marktweite Verschiebung nicht ausgleichen.

segments.src: ## Three forces driving the increases
segments.tr: ## Drei Kräfte, die die Erhöhungen vorantreiben

segments.src: ### 1. Storm and weather losses
segments.tr: ### 1. Sturm- und Wetterschäden

segments.src: Severe convective storms, including hail and high winds, have become a major source of insured losses in many parts of the country, alongside hurricanes, wildfires and flooding in more exposed areas.
segments.tr: Schwere konvektive Stürme, einschließlich Hagel und starkem Wind, sind in vielen Teilen des Landes zu einer Hauptquelle für versicherte Schäden geworden, neben Hurrikanen, Waldbränden und Überschwemmungen in stärker gefährdeten Gebieten.

segments.src: Insurers have reported several years in which payouts exceeded the premiums collected for homeowners lines in some states.
segments.tr: Versicherer haben von mehreren Jahren berichtet, in denen die Auszahlungen die für Wohngebäudeversicherungen eingenommenen Prämien in einigen Bundesstaaten überstiegen.

segments.src: Even moderate events add up when they happen frequently across many properties.
segments.tr: Selbst moderate Ereignisse summieren sich, wenn sie häufig bei vielen Immobilien auftreten.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher rebuilding costs
segments.tr: ### 2. Höhere Wiederaufbaukosten

segments.src: Homeowners insurance is generally designed to pay to repair or rebuild a home, not to buy it at its market price.
segments.tr: Die Wohngebäudeversicherung ist im Allgemeinen darauf ausgelegt, die Reparatur oder den Wiederaufbau eines Hauses zu bezahlen, nicht es zum Marktpreis zu kaufen.

segments.src: The cost to rebuild depends on lumber, roofing materials, appliances, labor and permitting, all of which rose sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: Die Kosten für den Wiederaufbau hängen von Holz, Dachmaterialien, Geräten, Arbeit und Genehmigungen ab, die alle in den letzten Jahren stark gestiegen sind.

segments.src: When construction costs climb, the amount an insurer must pay on a total or partial loss climbs with them.
segments.tr: Wenn die Baukosten steigen, steigt auch der Betrag, den ein Versicherer bei einem Total- oder Teilschaden zahlen muss.

segments.src: Many policies are adjusted automatically for this, which means the coverage limit and the premium can rise together even if the house itself has not changed.
segments.tr: Viele Policen werden automatisch daran angepasst, was bedeutet, dass die Deckungssumme und die Prämie zusammen steigen können, selbst wenn sich das Haus selbst nicht verändert hat.

segments.src: Labor shortages in the building trades and the expense of meeting updated building codes add further pressure.
segments.tr: Arbeitskräftemangel im Baugewerbe und die Kosten für die Einhaltung aktualisierter Bauvorschriften erhöhen den Druck zusätzlich.

segments.src: A repair that cost a certain amount a few years ago may cost noticeably more today.
segments.tr: Eine Reparatur, die vor ein paar Jahren einen bestimmten Betrag kostete, kann heute spürbar mehr kosten.

segments.src: ### 3. Reinsurance prices
segments.tr: ### 3. Rückversicherungspreise

segments.src: Insurers themselves buy insurance, known as reinsurance, to protect against catastrophic years.
segments.tr: Versicherer kaufen selbst Versicherungen, sogenannte Rückversicherungen, um sich gegen katastrophale Jahre abzusichern.

segments.src: Reinsurers have raised prices and tightened terms in response to large disaster losses, and those costs are passed down to primary insurers.
segments.tr: Rückversicherer haben als Reaktion auf große Katastrophenschäden die Preise erhöht und die Bedingungen verschärft, und diese Kosten werden an die Erstversicherer weitergegeben.

segments.src: Because reinsurance contracts often renew on a set annual schedule, increases can show up in consumer rates with a delay.
segments.tr: Da Rückversicherungsverträge oft nach einem festen jährlichen Zeitplan verlängert werden, können sich Erhöhungen bei den Verbrauchertarifen mit einer Verzögerung zeigen.

segments.src: An insurer that absorbed higher costs for a time may eventually seek larger rate increases to catch up.
segments.tr: Ein Versicherer, der eine Zeit lang höhere Kosten aufgefangen hat, wird möglicherweise schließlich größere Tariferhöhungen anstreben, um aufzuholen.

segments.src: Higher interest rates and the cost of capital also play a role, as insurers must hold reserves against potential losses.
segments.tr: Höhere Zinssätze und Kapitalkosten spielen ebenfalls eine Rolle, da Versicherer Reserven für potenzielle Verluste vorhalten müssen.

segments.src: ## Why some owners are losing coverage
segments.tr: ## Warum einige Eigentümer ihren Versicherungsschutz verlieren

segments.src: Rate increases are only part of the story.
segments.tr: Tariferhöhungen sind nur ein Teil der Geschichte.

segments.src: In some high-risk areas, insurers have stopped writing new policies, declined to renew existing ones, or reduced the number of homes they cover.
segments.tr: In einigen Hochrisikogebieten haben Versicherer aufgehört, neue Policen auszustellen, bestehende nicht verlängert oder die Anzahl der Häuser, die sie versichern, reduziert.

segments.src: State regulators generally review and approve rate changes, and in some states the approval process limits how quickly insurers can raise prices.
segments.tr: Staatliche Regulierungsbehörden prüfen und genehmigen in der Regel Tarifänderungen, und in einigen Bundesstaaten begrenzt der Genehmigungsprozess, wie schnell Versicherer die Preise erhöhen können.

segments.src: When insurers believe permitted rates do not match the risk, they may choose to reduce their exposure instead.
segments.tr: Wenn Versicherer glauben, dass die zulässigen Tarife nicht dem Risiko entsprechen, entscheiden sie sich möglicherweise stattdessen dafür, ihr Engagement zu reduzieren.

segments.src: Owners who cannot find coverage in the standard market may turn to state-backed insurers of last resort, often called FAIR Plans or similar programs.
segments.tr: Eigentümer, die auf dem Standardmarkt keinen Versicherungsschutz finden können, wenden sich möglicherweise an staatlich unterstützte Versicherer der letzten Instanz, die oft als FAIR Plans oder ähnliche Programme bezeichnet werden.

segments.src: These plans can be more expensive and may offer narrower protection.
segments.tr: Diese Pläne können teurer sein und bieten möglicherweise einen geringeren Schutz.

segments.src: Mortgage lenders require homeowners coverage, so losing a policy is not just an inconvenience.
segments.tr: Hypothekengeber verlangen eine Wohngebäudeversicherung, daher ist der Verlust einer Police nicht nur eine Unannehmlichkeit.

segments.src: It can create a compliance problem with the loan.
segments.tr: Es kann zu einem Compliance-Problem mit dem Kredit führen.

segments.src: ## What owners can do to lower the bill
segments.tr: ## Was Eigentümer tun können, um die Rechnung zu senken

segments.src: There is no way to fully escape a market-wide increase, but there are practical steps that may reduce what you pay.
segments.tr: Es gibt keine Möglichkeit, einer marktweiten Erhöhung vollständig zu entgehen, aber es gibt praktische Schritte, die Ihre Kosten senken können.

segments.src: - **Shop around.** Rates for the same home can differ widely between insurers. Get quotes from several companies or work with an independent agent who can compare multiple carriers. Do this well before your renewal date.
segments.tr: - **Vergleichen Sie Angebote.** Die Tarife für dasselbe Haus können zwischen den Versicherern stark variieren. Holen Sie Angebote von mehreren Unternehmen ein oder arbeiten Sie mit einem unabhängigen Makler zusammen, der mehrere Anbieter vergleichen kann. Tun Sie dies lange vor Ihrem Verlängerungsdatum.

segments.src: - **Review your coverage amount.** Make sure the dwelling limit reflects realistic rebuilding costs, not the market value of the home or the land. Overinsuring wastes money, while underinsuring can leave you exposed after a loss.

Überversicherung verschwendet Geld, während Unterversicherung Sie nach einem Schaden ungeschützt lassen kann.

segments.src: - **Raise your deductible.** Choosing a higher deductible can lower your premium, but only do so if you could comfortably pay that amount out of pocket. Check whether your policy has a separate, higher deductible for wind or hail.
segments.tr: - **Erhöhen Sie Ihren Selbstbehalt.** Die Wahl eines höheren Selbstbehalts kann Ihre Prämie senken, tun Sie dies jedoch nur, wenn Sie diesen Betrag bequem aus eigener Tasche zahlen könnten. Prüfen Sie, ob Ihre Police einen separaten, höheren Selbstbehalt für Wind oder Hagel hat.

In wildfire areas, clearing vegetation and using fire-resistant materials may matter. Ask your insurer exactly which improvements qualify.

segments.src: - **Bundle policies.** Combining home and auto coverage with the same company often yields a discount, though you should compare the bundled price with separate quotes.
segments.tr: - **Bündeln Sie Policen.** Die Kombination von Wohngebäude- und Kfz-Versicherung bei derselben Gesellschaft führt oft zu einem Rabatt, obwohl Sie den gebündelten Preis mit separaten Angeboten vergleichen sollten.

segments.src: - **Ask about all available discounts.** These can include loyalty, claim-free, paid-in-full, paperless billing and retiree discounts. Eligibility varies by company and state.
segments.tr: - **Fragen Sie nach allen verfügbaren Rabatten.** Dazu können Treue-, Schadenfreiheits-, Vorauszahlungs-, papierlose Abrechnungs- und Rentnerrabatte gehören. Die Anspruchsberechtigung variiert je nach Unternehmen und Bundesstaat.

Die Korrektur von Fehlern in Ihrer Kreditauskunft kann helfen, obwohl die Regeln je nach Bundesstaat unterschiedlich sind.

segments.src: - **Think twice before small claims.** Filing multiple small claims can raise your rates or affect renewal. Consider whether a minor repair is better paid directly.
segments.tr: - **Überlegen Sie es sich zweimal vor kleinen Schadensmeldungen.** Das Einreichen mehrerer kleiner Schäden kann Ihre Tarife erhöhen oder die Verlängerung beeinträchtigen. Überlegen Sie, ob eine kleinere Reparatur besser direkt bezahlt werden sollte.
